findings.message: not measured: docs/x.toml could not be read, so a read of a workflow's text in it cannot be seen
findings.fix: Make the file readable (permissions) and run the check again.

findings.message: reads a workflow file's text with a regular expression: the data it needs has one accessor
findings.fix: Read the data through the one accessor that owns it (`./dev ci conformance-args`, `cargo metadata`, the register's parser, a constant the owner exports; rule 79). A test of a check of workflows may read them: list the site (its path, a piece of the line and a reason) in conformance/c121-allow.json.
